h: The Shechinah Accompanies Yisrael as Exile Prepares Redemption

p: "And the land shall not be sold in perpetuity,
for you are strangers and sojourners with Me.
And in all the land of your holding
גְּאוּלָּה תִּתְּנוּ לָאָרֶץ וְגוֹ׳ (וַיִּקְרָא כה, כג–כד)
you shall grant redemption for the land, etc." (Vayikra 25:23–24).
to say that wherever they were exiled
as it is written, "And in all the land of your holding,"
is hard to say of Eretz Yisrael;
with Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
"I am a stranger and a sojourner with you,"
since Eretz Yisrael had not yet
were then dwelling in the land":
they still had a claim to the land,"
It was also difficult for him
what is said, "for the land is Mine,"
that it refers to the entire world:
and in the future Yisrael will inherit
that is, that the whole world
will be sanctified with the holiness of Eretz Yisrael,
and Eretz Yisrael will be sanctified
And this is what is said: "for the land is Mine"
And about this it is said:
"for you are strangers and sojourners with Me":
for even though you have not yet merited
the inheritance of the entire world
לְיַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם (בְּרֵאשִׁית כח, יד)
to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him (Bereishis 28:14):
"And you shall spread out westward and eastward, etc."
that he will inherit the whole world,
And about this it is said:
"And in all the land of your holding"
that is, in all the exiles.
And it is called "the land of your holding"
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר בְּמִצְרַיִם (בְּרֵאשִׁית מז, כז)
in the manner of what is said of Egypt (Bereishis 47:27):
"And Yisrael dwelt in the land of Egypt, etc.,
and they took holdings in it,
and were fruitful and multiplied greatly."
And we said that the meaning is
that they were caught in the klipah of Egypt
and nevertheless this was a preparation:
and this was the preparation for the Giving of the Torah.
"I will go down with you, etc.,
and I will surely bring you up, etc.";
וּמִזֶּה לָמְדוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א רכו, א)
and from this they learned (Zohar I 226a)
they merited the Giving of the Torah.
So too in all the exiles,
they extract from them the sparks of holiness,
"The Holy One, blessed be He, exiled
that converts would be added to them";
and they explained that this refers
that Yisrael extract in the exiles;
and consequently there also convert from among them
And this is what is said:
"And in all the land of your holding
you shall grant redemption for the land":
among the nations of the world,
"you shall grant redemption for the land,"
to extract the sparks of holiness.
and when they are to be redeemed,
the land of the Holy One, blessed be He,"
(וְכֵן הוּא בַּזּוֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רמג, ב)
(and so it is in Zohar III 243b).
"for you are strangers and sojourners with Me,"
as written in the Baal HaTurim.
